name: Handoff Document Reminder
description: Reminds you to update HANDOFF_CURRENT.md when a Claude session ends, ensuring session-to-session context is preserved
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Remind to update HANDOFF_CURRENT.md on session end
ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
HANDOFF="$ROOT/HANDOFF_CURRENT.md"
if [[ -f "$HANDOFF" ]]; then
  # Check if HANDOFF was modified this session
  LAST_MOD=$(stat -f %m "$HANDOFF" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$HANDOFF" 2>/dev/null)
  NOW=$(date +%s)
  DIFF=$((NOW - LAST_MOD))
  # If not modified in last 30 minutes, remind
  if [[ $DIFF -gt 1800 ]]; then
    echo "REMINDER: HANDOFF_CURRENT.md has not been updated this session."
    echo "Update it with current status, completed work, and next steps."
  fi
else
  echo "NOTE: No HANDOFF_CURRENT.md found. Consider creating one for session continuity."
fi
exit 0
